publisher: Zenodo; originating researchers: Praetz, Sebastian (Technische Universität Berlin); Johansen, Morten; Schlesiger, Christopher; Kober, Delf (Technische Universität Berlin)

author_preprocessing: Authors report 300-second initial spectra and 3x/5x binning to 15–25-minute spectra. Some data are absorption mu(E), references and binned products; LFP unbinned series is also retained.
known_analyses_and_limitations: The DANOISE operando XAS study is DOI 10.1039/D5JA00155B. Different spectra can summarize overlapping physical intervals. Time-to-spectrum assignment and electrode conditions must be checked before combining systems; calibrated spectra are not detector-event telemetry.
